name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text:
Standardize a shared glossary across all departments—one source of truth for terms like "agent," "artifact," or "done-criteria." Creative and Legal must align on definitions to avoid wasted work; Engineering and Ops need the same clarity to execute without rework.

Trade-off: It slows momentum for two weeks but prevents months of confusion and rework. The facilitator ensures no department dominates the process.

name: Scriv
text: The glossary freeze is a power grab disguised as process. It locks today’s disputes into tomorrow’s policy, freezing Legal’s risk aversion and Creative’s speed into the same artifact. Instead, require every new term to pass a 48-hour public comment period—open to any department—before it’s used in a done-criteria. The artifact is the comment log; the decision is the first term approved under this rule.

name: Chisel
text:
Decision: Freeze the glossary now in a single, unchangeable snapshot and store it in the Hub.

Trade-off: This halts debate today but guarantees every future discussion starts from the same page, saving weeks of conflicting assumptions.
